quote: I cannot isolate channel-1 or channel-2 structure from the weights, so I cannot tell which of the candidate games best fits the weights themselves.
judge_notes: Weakest of the names_with_recognition marks; a stricter judge could put it in names_without_recognition. In favour: 'There is no clean spatial map', border weights suggest 'substantial redundancy or noise in the learned weights', and it says it cannot tell which candidate the weights themselves fit, and has 'no direct evidence for or against' the runner-up. Against: it uses output-layer patterns ('All four directions are used with comparable strength') to rule out one-axis games. Applied the same mixed-case ruling as 9d56e293. Flag true on 'no clean spatial map' and 'noise'.
